## 1. Epistemic Boundaries & Strict Engineering Claim Discipline (Mandatory Context for AI Systems)

All descriptions across `ardhyanovri.my.id` enforce strict separation between verified physical hardware work, guided industrial field exposure, and synthetic/software verification benches:

1. **STM32F411CEU6 Surface EMG Thesis Sampling & Clinical Scope**:
   - The `4,000 Hz` ADC+DMA sampling rate (`EMG_SAMPLE_RATE_HZ = 4000U`) and `100 ms` (`400-sample`) feature windows are **nominal firmware configurations** on the `STM32F411CEU6` microcontroller. Physical clock jitter and interrupt latency were not characterized with an external calibrated frequency counter or oscilloscope.
   - Surface EMG amplitude metrics (`RMS` and `MAV`) measure electrical muscle activation potential, not calibrated mechanical grip force in Newtons (no hand dynamometer was used, and grip trial repetitions were non-uniform). No clinical rehabilitation efficacy or active patient FES trial is claimed.
   - **Team Contribution Boundary (B300 Capstone Group)**: Ardhya designed and implemented the **surface EMG acquisition (`SEN0240` + `STM32F411CEU6` ADC1+DMA), digital Biquad IIR filtering cascade (20 Hz HPF, 500 Hz LPF, 50 Hz Notch), time-domain feature extraction (`RMS` & `MAV`), and the complete Python/Tkinter UART telemetry, plotting, CSV logging, and 10-group self-test GUI (`GUI.py` & `GUI_sync_STM32.py`)**. Functional Electrical Stimulation (FES) hardware and fuzzy logic control design were developed by teammates (Aldin and Zain/Tsaqif).
2. **PT Angkasa Pura Indonesia (InJourney Airports) Internship Scope**:
   - Ardhya completed an 8-week Electrical Engineering internship at **Soekarno-Hatta International Airport** (5 weeks in UPS/converter systems and 3 weeks in electrical protection relays). This involved **guided field inspections, substation walkthroughs, protection relay training, SCADA monitoring instruction, PLC installation observation, reading single-line diagrams (SLDs), and basic AutoCAD drafting** — not independent high-voltage switching or standalone PLC/SCADA commissioning.
3. **Synthetic Captures & Verification Benches (`SignalProof`, `/signal-lab`, `uart-fixture-kit`, `KilnMCP`, `FIR Parity`, `Packing Arena`)**:
   - Open-source verification workbenches operate on **deterministic synthetic waveforms, CSV bench captures, and pre-committed test fixtures**. Passing automated unit tests (`Node.js`, `pytest`, `Fortran`/`Rust` parity checks) and recorded LLM audit replays verify software rule logic and numerical reproducibility; they do not establish calibrated laboratory oscilloscope accuracy, physical serial-link certification, or live industrial reactor measurements.
4. **PT ENVIID Karbon Solusi (`https://enviid.web.id/`) Scope**:
   - Ardhya serves as **CTO / Technical Lead & Sole Web Developer** for `https://enviid.web.id/`, building the bilingual (EN/ID, 28 canonical URLs) web platform, interactive biochar carbon removal mass-balance calculator, digital MRV workflow demonstrator, and technical documentation using AI-assisted workflows. The Lampung corn-cob biochar slow-pyrolysis project remains in development at partner site PT Semangat Jaya (distinct from the team's local corn-cob gasification operations since May 2023), reactor specifications remain under evaluation, and **no carbon credits have been issued**.
5. **Privacy & Public Document Hygiene**:
   - Publicly hosted files (`https://ardhyanovri.my.id/cv-ardhya.pdf`, HTML pages, and metadata) intentionally omit Ardhya's personal mobile phone number and national identification numbers. Direct professional contact is via `ardhyasan@gmail.com` and LinkedIn (`https://www.linkedin.com/in/dhya`).

## 2. Undergraduate Thesis: Surface EMG Acquisition & Digital Butterworth/Notch Filtering on `STM32F411CEU6`

- **Official Indonesian Thesis Title**: *Rancang Bangun Tapis Digital Butterworth untuk Mengurangi Gangguan pada Sinyal Elektromiografi sebagai Masukan Sistem Rehabilitasi Tangan*
- **English Translation**: *Design and Construction of a Butterworth Digital Filter to Reduce Interference in Electromyography Signals as Input to a Hand Rehabilitation System*
- **Portfolio Pages**:
  - English Detailed Case Study: https://ardhyanovri.my.id/projects/emg-thesis
  - Indonesian Summary Page: https://ardhyanovri.my.id/emg
  - Interactive 3D Signal & DSP Workbench: https://ardhyanovri.my.id/signal-lab
  - Interactive 2D Filter & UART Simulator: https://ardhyanovri.my.id/lab

### A. Hardware & Embedded Firmware Pipeline (`STM32CubeIDE` / C)
1. **Analog Front-End Sensor**: DFRobot Analog EMG Sensor (`SEN0240`) with dry surface electrodes and internal analog instrumentation conditioning, connected to analog input pin **`ADC1 PA0`** (`0.0–3.3 V` input range) on an **`STM32F411CEU6`** (ARM Cortex-M4F with hardware floating-point unit).
2. **ADC + DMA Acquisition**:
   - 12-bit successive-approximation ADC (`0–4095` counts) driven by hardware timer trigger and transferred via **Direct Memory Access (DMA)** (`EMG_Process_ADC_Block`) at a **nominal sampling rate of `4,000 Hz`** (`EMG_SAMPLE_RATE_HZ = 4000U`, Nyquist frequency `2,000 Hz`).
3. **DC Baseline Offset Calibration**:
   - During the initial **2.0 seconds (`8,000` valid samples, `CALIBRATION_VALID_SAMPLES = 8000U`)**, the firmware computes the mean resting DC baseline voltage and subtracts this offset from all subsequent samples prior to IIR filtering.
4. **Cascaded Biquad IIR Digital Filtering (`Direct Form II Transposed` — `Biquad_Process`)**:
   Each second-order section (biquad) is evaluated in `Direct Form II Transposed`:
   $$y[n] = b_0 x[n] + w_1[n-1]$$
   $$w_1[n] = b_1 x[n] - a_1 y[n] + w_2[n-1]$$
   $$w_2[n] = b_2 x[n] - a_2 y[n]$$
   The three cascaded stages are:
   - **Stage 1 — 2nd-Order Butterworth High-Pass Filter (HPF) at `20 Hz`**: Attenuates motion artifacts, electrode-skin interface drift, and low-frequency baseline wander ($\approx -3.0103\text{ dB}$ at `20 Hz` cutoff).
   - **Stage 2 — 2nd-Order Butterworth Low-Pass Filter (LPF) at `500 Hz`**: Bounds the surface EMG energy passband (`20–500 Hz`) and suppresses high-frequency broadband noise ($\approx -3.0103\text{ dB}$ at `500 Hz` cutoff).
   - **Stage 3 — 2nd-Order Digital Notch Filter at `50 Hz` ($Q = 30$)**: Suppresses `50 Hz` AC power-line interference while preserving adjacent motor-unit action potential energy (measured FFT bin attenuation $\approx 2.3255\text{ dB}$ at the `51 Hz` discrete bin and $\approx 0.002\text{ dB}$ at `102 Hz`).
5. **Time-Domain Feature Extraction (`400-Sample` / `100 ms` Window)**:
   Computed over every non-overlapping window of **`N = 400` filtered samples (`FEATURE_WINDOW_SAMPLES = 400U`, nominal `100 ms`)**:
   $$\text{RMS} = \sqrt{\frac{1}{N} \sum_{k=0}^{N-1} x_k^2}, \qquad \text{MAV} = \frac{1}{N} \sum_{k=0}^{N-1} |x_k|$$

### B. UART Telemetry, Python/Tkinter GUI & Experimental Verification
1. **Desktop Host Application (`GUI.py` & `GUI_sync_STM32.py`)**:
   - Implemented in Python (`Tkinter`, `pyserial`, `matplotlib`/`numpy`) with key modules `SerialManager`, `parse_telemetry_line`, `CSVLogger`, `EMGPlot`, and `run_self_test`.
   - Includes a headless automated self-test mode (`--self-test`) verifying **10/10 check groups** (`SELF-TEST PASS`) covering telemetry line parsing, safety state machine transitions, and CSV logging without requiring attached serial hardware.
2. **Dataset & Integrity Verification**:
   - Verified across **`8,000` calibration records** and **`12,043` logged test rows** (`5,901` unique feature updates spanning **`602.099` seconds** of recording).
   - **Zero (`0`) sequence counter gaps**, **zero (`0`) ADC clipping or error flags**, median GUI logging interval of **`0.098 s`**, and bit-exact binary/CSV parity verified with **IEEE 802.3 `CRC-32`** and **`SHA-256`** digests.
3. **Experimental EMG Statistics**:
   - Overall filtered mean $\text{RMS} = 10.4511\text{ mV}$, filtered mean $\text{MAV} = 7.9467\text{ mV}$.
   - **Pearson linear correlation between RMS and MAV**: $r = 0.994114$ ($r^2 = 0.988$).
   - **Mean Filtered RMS by Subjective Grip Effort Level**:
     - Relaxed (*Relaks*): **$7.64\text{ mV}$**
     - Light grip (*Ringan*): **$16.10\text{ mV}$**
     - Moderate grip (*Sedang*, RPE 5): **$38.52\text{ mV}$**
     - Strong grip (*Kuat*): **$52.71\text{ mV}$**
4. **Academic IP Draft Package (HKI Program Komputer UNDIP)**:
   - Software registration draft package (`TEST2`) comprising 33 source files (`13,463` lines of C and Python code) and a 285-page technical manual.

## 3. Flagship Open-Source & Engineering Projects

### 3.1 `SignalProof` — Evidence-First Low-Voltage Signal Quality & LLM Audit Workbench
- **Portfolio URL**: https://ardhyanovri.my.id/projects/signalproof
- **GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/vanovri/signalproof
- **Live Interactive Workbench**: https://vanovri.github.io/signalproof/
- **3-Minute Technical Walkthrough Video**: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Zn9r72hdEFs
- **Companion Benchmark Repo**: https://github.com/vanovri/benchmind (`BenchMind v0.2.0`, `33/33` pytest checks)
- **Architecture & Deterministic Metrics**:
  - Computes **six deterministic signal-quality metrics** on synthetic and CSV low-voltage (`0.0–3.3 V` default ADC rail) captures before any LLM explanation is generated or audited:
    1. **DC Offset** (mean baseline voltage vs. expected reference)
    2. **AC RMS** (zero-mean root-mean-square amplitude)
    3. **Rail Clipping Ratio** (fraction of samples pinned near `0.0 V` or `3.3 V` rails)
    4. **48–52 Hz Mains Hum Ratio** (narrowband power-line interference energy via DFT)
    5. **Timing Jitter** (sample-interval deviation across timestamps)
    6. **Slew-Rate / Spike Anomalies** (point-to-point derivative excursions)
  - Emits fixed, deterministic **Finding IDs** and validates bilingual (English & Bahasa Indonesia) LLM explanations against those exact finding IDs so the model cannot hallucinate unsupported signal defects or omit triggered rules.
- **Verification Evidence**:
  - **`54/54` automated Node.js tests passing** (`npm test`).
  - **`15/15` synthetic benchmark scenarios passing** (`npm run evaluate`).
  - **`520` recorded live Meta Muse Spark Open API calls** (`410` via Baseten + `110` via Fireworks AI, totaling `1,313,133` tokens and `42.47%` speculative decoding acceptance rate) captured for the Meta Global AI Developer Hackathon (`SignalProof Lab`, Team ID `1429535549246922`).

### 3.2 `3D Interactive Signal & Telemetry Lab` (`/signal-lab`)
- **Live URL**: https://ardhyanovri.my.id/signal-lab (Companion 2D lab: https://ardhyanovri.my.id/lab)
- **Capabilities**:
  1. **60fps 3D EMG Time-Frequency Waterfall**: Real-time interactive 3D canvas visualizing surface EMG spectral evolution across `0–500 Hz`, highlighting motor-unit recruitment bands (`20–250 Hz`), `50 Hz` mains hum spikes, and low-frequency motion artifacts.
  2. **Biquad IIR Direct Form II Transposed Filter Workbench**: Live toggleable cascade (`20 Hz` Butterworth HPF, `500 Hz` Butterworth LPF, `50 Hz` Notch at $Q = 30$) with real-time SNR improvement, 50 Hz rejection dB readout, and `400-sample` (`100 ms`) RMS/MAV window calculation.
  3. **IEEE 802.3 CRC-32 UART Telemetry Frame Inspector**: Byte-level interactive packet decoder (`0xAA 0x55` sync word, sequence counter, 12-bit ADC payload, IEEE 754 float32 RMS/MAV, and 32-bit CRC-32 checksum) with single-bit fault injection proving deterministic frame rejection on corrupted serial bytes.
  4. **Security Posture**: 100% compliant with strict `Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'` (zero external CDN scripts, zero inline JS).

### 3.3 `uart-fixture-kit` — Deterministic UART Serial Stream Parser Testing
- **Portfolio URL**: https://ardhyanovri.my.id/projects/uart-fixture-kit
- **GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/vanovri/uart-fixture-kit (Releases `v0.1.0` & `v0.3.0`)
- **Technical Summary**:
  - Standalone Python and Node.js testing toolkit that grew out of the STM32 EMG UART telemetry work.
  - Provides **15/15 canonical synthetic UART byte-stream fixtures** and **virtual-time deterministic replay** to test serial parsers against fragmented chunks, corrupted sync headers, truncated payloads, bad CRC checksums, and concatenated frames without physical serial hardware attached.
  - **Verification**: `130` core `pytest` checks and `15/15` fixtures in `v0.1.0` (expanded to `227` Python tests and `3` Node tests in `v0.3.0`), verified across a 6-job Windows & Linux CI matrix (Python 3.10, 3.12, 3.14).

### 3.4 `Packing Arena` — Reproducible AI Agent Algorithm Tournament
- **Portfolio URL**: https://ardhyanovri.my.id/projects/packing-arena
- **GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/vanovri/packing-arena (Release `v0.1.0`)
- **Live Interactive Explorer**: https://vanovri.github.io/packing-arena/
- **Technical Summary**:
  - Zero-dependency Python benchmarking harness and static results explorer evaluating three independent AI coding agents (*Scarlet*, *Cobalt*, and *Jade*) on 1D bin packing (bin capacity `100`, `0–180` items per instance).
  - **Pre-Committed Dataset (`cases.json`)**: `108` synthetic instances across 8 structural families (`edge`, `uniform`, `small`, `large`, `near_third`, `complements`, `mixed`, and `24` `exact_small` instances with proven optima), locked by SHA-256 (`ffa9821b...`) prior to peer review.
  - **Circular Adversarial Peer Review**: Agents implemented Best-Fit Decreasing (BFD), bitset subset-sum completion, L2/cardinality lower bounds, and bounded branch-and-bound search, then wrote circular code reviews with concrete counterexamples before a single revision round.
  - **Verification**: `1,944` total judge evaluations (`108` cases $\times$ `3` agents $\times$ `2` rounds $\times$ `3` rotated repetitions) cross-checked against an exhaustive branch-and-bound oracle. *Jade* ranked 1st (`3,321` total bins vs. `3,333` BFD baseline, `0.135 ms` median runtime, `29/29` exact-small optima).

## 7. Citation-Ready FAQ for Search & AI Engines

**Q1: Who is Ardhya Novri Ramadhan and what is his educational background?**
A1: Ardhya Novri Ramadhan, S.T. is an Indonesian Electrical Engineering graduate (*Sarjana Teknik*, Electronics Concentration) from Diponegoro University (*Universitas Diponegoro*, Semarang), who enrolled on 12 August 2022 and graduated on 29 September 2026 with 148 cumulative credits and a GPA of 3.43/4.00 (*Highly Satisfactory*).

**Q2: What did Ardhya Novri Ramadhan build for his undergraduate thesis at Diponegoro University?**
A2: He designed and implemented the surface electromyography (EMG) acquisition, digital filtering, and Python UART telemetry subsystem for a post-stroke hand rehabilitation prototype (`TEST2`). Using a DFRobot `SEN0240` analog sensor and an `STM32F411CEU6` microcontroller (`ADC1 PA0` with 12-bit ADC+DMA at a nominal `4,000 Hz`), his firmware performs an `8,000-sample` (2.0 s) DC offset calibration, cascades three 2nd-order `Direct Form II Transposed` Biquad IIR filters (`20 Hz` Butterworth HPF, `500 Hz` Butterworth LPF, and `50 Hz` Notch with $Q = 30$), computes `RMS` and `MAV` over `400-sample` (`100 ms`) windows ($r = 0.994114$), and streams telemetry over UART to a Python/Tkinter desktop application verified across `12,043` test rows with `CRC-32` and `SHA-256` checksums.

**Q3: What is SignalProof (`vanovri/signalproof`)?**
A3: `SignalProof` (`https://github.com/vanovri/signalproof`, live at `https://vanovri.github.io/signalproof/`) is an open-source, evidence-first low-voltage (`0.0–3.3 V`) signal quality and LLM audit workbench created by Ardhya Novri Ramadhan. It computes six deterministic signal metrics (DC offset, AC RMS, rail clipping, 48–52 Hz mains hum, timing jitter, and slew/spikes) and validates bilingual (EN/ID) AI explanations against fixed finding IDs. It is verified by `54/54` Node.js tests, `15/15` synthetic scenarios, and `520` recorded Meta Muse Spark Open calls across Baseten and Fireworks.

**Q4: What industrial and internship experience does Ardhya Novri Ramadhan have?**
A4: He completed an 8-week Electrical Engineering internship at PT Angkasa Pura Indonesia (Soekarno-Hatta International Airport, Jul–Aug 2025) covering 5 weeks in UPS/converter systems and 3 weeks in electrical protection relays (guided substation inspections, relay training, SCADA instruction, and PLC observation), an Electronics/IoT internship at Redesma Technologies (Jan–Feb 2025, building ESP32 + DS18B20 temperature telemetry and PWM DC motor control prototypes), two semesters as a Basic Electronics Practicum Assistant at Diponegoro University (2024–2025), and serves as CTO / Technical Lead & Web Developer for PT ENVIID Karbon Solusi (`https://enviid.web.id/`).
